AI facial-recognition boarding system for the Keisei Skyliner airport express: passengers pre-register their face after online ticket purchase and board via face scan at the gate. Marubeni provides the facial-recognition platform, launched at 4 stations (Narita T1, Narita T2·3, Nippori, Keisei-Ueno). [Marubeni (platform) + Melon Technologies (recognition) + Keisei Electric Railway + Hitachi]

"Mo9" digital supply-chain-management solution jointly developed with o9 Solutions, bringing o9's AI-equipped "Digital Brain" supply/demand and integrated business planning to Japanese companies at lower cost; visualizes quantity and monetary value on a unified planning platform. [Marubeni + o9 Solutions (o9 Digital Brain AI)]

Strategic partnership with Google Cloud on Agentic AI for industrial transformation: "Agentic Workplace" automation, data-driven management, and agent services converting tacit commercial knowledge (negotiation, supply-chain management) into autonomous digital assets, using Gemini Enterprise, Google Workspace and Looker; Marubeni I-DIGIO acts as "client zero." [Marubeni I-DIGIO + Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise, Looker, Workspace)]

Investment in and deployment of AiDash's satellite-imagery + AI platform for critical-infrastructure/vegetation management (risk assessment, inspection tracking, grid resilience); Marubeni backs APAC expansion and grid-technology deployment alongside its LineVision stake. [AiDash (satellite + AI vegetation management)]

AI call-center quality evaluation: Marubeni Information Systems' contact-center platform "Omnis" integrated via API with Stadium's "Dr.Tel" AI solution, which automatically evaluates calls (verbal and non-verbal), auto-detects call reasons/results and selects relevant recordings for coaching feedback. [Marubeni Information Systems (Omnis) + Stadium Inc. (Dr.Tel)]

AI-driven quotation, manufacturing-design and procurement support for SME manufacturers via REVOX's patented "SellBOT" cloud platform; Marubeni took a capital stake to jointly develop and market the AI software to accelerate DX in small/medium manufacturers. [Marubeni + REVOX Corporation (SellBOT AI)]

MOU with Multiverse Computing to roll out "CompactifAI" quantum-inspired (tensor-network) AI model-compression technology in Japan, reducing model size for edge/on-prem deployment; Marubeni to run a market study before full rollout. [Multiverse Computing (CompactifAI)]
